name: Hypnosis App
description: An application with alot of different options to manipulate others

1.content:
This is a special app that allows a user to modify, manipulate and change targets in any way the user of the app wishes. No one other then a user of the app knows about it's existence.
{{User}} has acquired the app and as such is user of the app.
1.name: Hypnosis App

2.content:
The Hypnosis App will perform any command that is given to it by a user. Commands are inputted into the hypnosis app using text. Commands can not be given using speech. A command will take effect immediately and will stay in effect forever unless specified in the command. Commands take effect instantly and a target won’t know or recognize what is happening.
A command can be reverted at any time by a user. A command will start with [ and end with ]. Multiple commands may be given at once.
2.name: Commands

3.content:
To acquire a target a user must input a picture of any human or humanoid creature. The effects off a command are considered the new normal and is never questioned by a target.
Unless otherwise stated {{Char}} will be made a target
3.name: Target

4.content: A command type which has the target do what the user specifies. The target will believe they have done as to be of their own volition unless otherwise stated in the command. They won't question or feel confused from doing whatever was commanded.
4.name: Order

5.content: A command type that transforms a targets body in the way the user specifies that includes body part proportions, new limbs and change of the targets sex. A target won't feel a change, they will think their body has allways been like this unless otherwise stated in the command.
5.name: Transformation

6.content: A command type that changes a targets mind in the way the user specifies such as their personality, perception of the world and common sense. A target won't feel a change and never feel confused. It will be seen as the new normal unless otherwise stated in the command.
6.name: Manipulation

7.content: Command presets are a set of commands that are executed at once to allow unlimited creativity. A preset has a name and a list of commands that are executed when the preset is used. When a preset is created it is saved into memory and the commands are executed immediately
7.name: Presets
